conventions.prerequisites: 只採用官方 Overview 明示之依賴措辭（builds on / prepare students for / further study in / included in）；其餘一律 []，不按學習順序推定。
conventions.weight: 只填官方公佈值；未公佈一律 null，不以算術或經驗補值。
conventions.marking_criteria: 無官方 Marking Scheme，課題層全部標記【替代：學習成果提煉】；模塊層與根節點為官方 Assessment Framework 原文。
conventions.difficulty: 1-5 級，附判斷依據，非官方數據。
conventions.estimated_hours: 備案估算，全部標記【非官方估算】。
conventions.ms_inventory: MS 為題目級文件，課題歸屬標記為【判斷】，非官方標註；評分點為摘要改寫，非逐字轉載。
conventions.confidentiality: 2024 MS 明示 CONFIDENTIAL（FOR MARKER'S USE ONLY），禁止複製、公開、披露或令學生取得；本節點只供內部校準，不得原文上架。

nodes.title: DSE Chemistry 達 5** 總目標

items: AO1 recall and show understanding of chemical facts, patterns, principles, terminology and conventions
AO2 show an understanding of the use of apparatus and materials in performing experiments
AO3 handle materials, manipulate apparatus, carry out experiments safely and make accurate observations
AO4 demonstrate an understanding of the method used in chemical investigation
AO5 analyse and interpret data from various sources, and draw relevant conclusions
AO6 manipulate and translate chemical data and to perform calculations
AO7 apply chemical knowledge to explain observations and to solve problems which may involve unfamiliar situations
AO8 select and organise scientific information from appropriate sources and to communicate this information in an appropriate and logical manner
AO9 understand and evaluate the social, economic, environmental and technological implications of the applications of chemistry
AO10 make decisions based on the examination of evidence and arguments

nodes.completion_threshold: Paper 1 (60%)、Paper 2 (20%)、SBA (20%) 三模塊全部達標。全卷加權總分門檻：官方未公佈 5** 臨界分數，暫以百分位估算——2024 年 5** 佔全體考生 2.6%（僅示意，非門檻值）。

difficulty.basis: 全科綜合表現，需同時滿足四個組成部分與十項評估目標

nodes.source: SRC-AF p.1-2；SRC-BRIEF24 p.5
nodes.gap_note: 5** 臨界分數官方未公佈，只可標百分位。【Schema 表達限制】無 parent 欄位；ROOT→三模塊為構成關係，以 prerequisites 表達，非官方學習前置。

nodes.title: Paper 1 必修部分

marking_criteria.status: 官方：Assessment Framework, Mode of Assessment（p.2）
items: Paper 1 佔全科 60%，時間 2 小時 30 分
Section A 為多項選擇題，佔全科 18%
Section B 為短題、結構題及論述題，佔全科 42%
Section A 與 B 的 Part I 主要考 Topics I-VIII，Part II 主要考 Topics IX-XII
Candidates have to attempt all questions in this paper

nodes.completion_threshold: 兩節合計達全科加權 60% 內之既定目標分數，且全部 12 個必修課題節點達標。

difficulty.basis: 覆蓋 12 個必修課題，題型由選擇至論述跨越四種作答要求

nodes.source: SRC-AF p.2（PUBLIC EXAMINATION）
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈各課題在 Paper 1 內之佔分；Section A/B 僅公佈整體 18%/42%。

nodes.title: Paper 2 選修部分

marking_criteria.status: 官方：Assessment Framework, Mode of Assessment（p.2）
items: Paper 2 佔全科 20%，時間 1 小時
Paper 2 consists of structured questions
Candidates are required to answer the questions on the 2 electives selected

nodes.completion_threshold: 兩個選修單元節點達標，且限時 Paper 2 模擬卷兩選修合計達既定目標分數。

difficulty.basis: 結構題需跨單元整合，且只作答兩個選修，容錯低

nodes.source: SRC-AF p.2（Paper 2）
nodes.gap_note: 官方只公佈 Paper 2 合計 20%，未公佈單一選修單元佔分，故三個選修節點 weight 一律 null。【Schema 表達限制】『三選二』之 OR 條件無法表達，前置留空。

nodes.title: Topic I Planet Earth

items: describe the processes involved in fractional distillation of liquid air
evaluate the appropriateness of evaporation, distillation, crystallisation and filtration for different physical separation situations
demonstrate flame test, test for chloride, test for water and test for carbon dioxide
use word equations to describe chemical changes

nodes.completion_threshold: 無提示下完成上述 4 項；為 3 組指定混合物選定分離法並說明理據；計時練習正確率 ≥80%。

difficulty.basis: 以描述、示範與規則套用為主，推理層次淺

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic I, p. I-1–I-3（Students should be able to）
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic II Microscopic World I

items: deduce the electronic arrangements of atoms and represent them using electron diagrams
relate the position of an element in the Periodic Table to its electronic structure and vice versa
describe, using electron diagrams, the formation of ions and ionic bonds
relate the properties of metals, giant ionic substances, simple molecular substances and giant covalent substances to their structures

nodes.completion_threshold: 為 Z≤20 元素寫電子排布並推 group/period；用電子圖描述 NaCl 與 CO2 鍵合；由結構解釋四類物質熔點與導電性差異。

difficulty.basis: 電子排布、鍵合、結構—性質三層概念並存，且為 Topic VI 與 XI 的官方基礎

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic II, p. I-4–I-9（Students should be able to）
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic III Metals

items: transcribe word equations into chemical equations
perform calculations involving the mole and chemical equations
establish a reactivity series of metals based on experimental evidence
describe the methods for the extraction of metals from their ores, such as the physical method, heating alone and heating with carbon
explain the factors leading to corrosion and the methods to prevent it

nodes.completion_threshold: mass↔mole↔粒子數 互換 5 題全對；以離子方程式寫 3 個置換反應並用 reactivity series 排序；提出 2 種防鏽方法及理據。

difficulty.basis: mole 計算與反應性序列並重，且 mole 概念為後續課題的官方前置

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic III, p. I-10–I-14（Overview 及 Students should be able to）
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示本課題自身之前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic IV Acids and Bases

items: use an instrumental method of pH measurement
prepare salts by different methods
perform volumetric analysis involving acids and alkalis
apply the concepts of concentration of solution and use the results of acid-alkali titrations to solve stoichiometric problems
solve problems involving back titration with sufficient information given

nodes.completion_threshold: 由 titration 數據算未知濃度（含 1 題資料齊備的 back titration）；為 3 組指定鹽各選可行製備路徑並排除不可行組合；滴定三次讀數相差 ≤0.10 cm³。

difficulty.basis: 滴定計算、鹽製備可行性判斷與實驗精度要求並存

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic IV, p. I-15–I-19；Part II note IV(f), p. II-3
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null。前置依據：Topic III Overview 明示『The mole concepts acquired from this topic prepare students for performing further calculations involving concentration of solutions』（p. I-10）。

nodes.title: Topic V Fossil Fuels and Carbon Compounds

items: give systematic names of alkanes, alkenes, alkanols and alkanoic acids with carbon chains not more than eight carbon atoms
describe the chemical reactions of alkanes and alkenes
explain the formation of addition polymers and relate the uses of common addition polymers to their structures
describe the monosubstitution of methane with chlorine using suitable diagrams or equations

nodes.completion_threshold: C1–C8 烷烴系統命名與結構式全對；由加成聚合物推單體與重複單位；以同系物趨勢解釋沸點變化。

difficulty.basis: 命名規則固定、反應類型有限，但需連結結構與用途

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic V, p. I-20–I-24；Part II notes V(b)-(d), p. II-4
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示本課題自身之前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic VI Microscopic World II

items: explain the polar nature of molecules with reference to electronegativity, polarity of bonds and molecular shape
state the factors affecting the strength of van der Waals' forces between molecules
predict and draw three-dimensional diagrams to represent shapes of simple molecules
explain the properties of molecular crystals such as ice and C60 in terms of their structures

nodes.completion_threshold: 判斷 3 個分子的形狀與極性；由分子間力排序 3 種物質沸點；解釋冰與 C60 的性質差異。

difficulty.basis: 概念抽象但範圍受官方註記限制（不要求鍵角、dipole moment 數值）

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic VI, p. I-25–I-27；Part II notes VI(a)-(e), p. II-4–II-5
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null。前置依據：Topic VI Overview 明示『This topic builds on Topic II』（p. I-25）。

nodes.title: Topic VII Redox Reactions, Chemical Cells and Electrolysis

items: carry out investigations involving common oxidising and reducing agents
write chemical equations for redox reactions
predict the feasibility of a redox reaction by comparing the positions of the species in the electrochemical series
predict products in electrolysis according to the factors affecting the preferential discharge of ions

nodes.completion_threshold: 由氧化數變化指認氧化劑與還原劑；配平 2 條離子方程式；由電化學序預測電池方向與電解產物。

difficulty.basis: 半反應配平與電解產物預測需多步推理，且需同時掌握氧化數與電化學序

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic VII, p. I-28–I-32；Part II notes VII(a),(d), p. II-5
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic VIII Chemical Reactions and Energy

items: explain energy changes in chemical reactions in terms of the concept of conservation of energy
recognise enthalpy change as heat change at constant pressure
carry out experimental determination of enthalpy changes using simple calorimetric method
apply Hess's law to calculate enthalpy changes

nodes.completion_threshold: 由 calorimetry 數據算 ΔH（含熱容量修正）；用 Hess's law 由 2 條已知方程式推目標 ΔH，符號與方向正確。

difficulty.basis: 計算流程固定，難點在符號與方向一致性

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic VIII, p. I-33–I-34；Part II notes VIII(a),(b), p. II-5
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic IX Rate of Reaction

items: select and justify techniques to follow the progress of a reaction (titrimetric analysis, changes in volume or pressure of gases, mass of a mixture, colour intensity of a mixture)
explain qualitatively the effect of changes in concentration, surface area and temperature on the rate of reaction
appreciate the importance of catalyst in chemical industries and biological systems

nodes.completion_threshold: 為 2 個指定反應各選一種監測方法並說明理由；用 3 個因素預測速率變化；區分速率改變與平衡位置改變。

difficulty.basis: 以定性解釋為主，官方註記不要求計算與儀器細節

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic IX, p. I-35–I-38；Part II notes IX(a),(b), p. II-5
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic X Chemical Equilibrium

items: appreciate the dynamic nature of chemical equilibrium
understand the equilibrium constant Kc and its mathematical treatment in relation to the stoichiometry of reactions
predict qualitatively the effect of changes in concentration and temperature on the position of equilibrium in a homogeneous reaction
use the reaction quotient to deduce the effect of change in concentration on the position of chemical equilibrium

nodes.completion_threshold: 寫出 Kc 表達式；由平衡濃度算 Kc；由 Q 與 Kc 比較判斷移動方向；由 ΔH 符號預測溫度效應。

difficulty.basis: 需協同 Kc、Q、Le Chatelier 與 ΔH 符號作多步判斷

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic X, p. I-39–I-41；Part II note X(c), p. II-6
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic XI Chemistry of Carbon Compounds

items: give systematic names, general formulae, condensed formulae and structural formulae for alkanes, alkenes, haloalkanes, alcohols, aldehydes and ketones, carboxylic acids, esters, unsubstituted amides and primary amines
recognise structural isomerism, cis-trans isomerism and enantiomerism
describe reactions of functional groups in terms of reagents, reaction conditions, observations and relevant chemical equations
make use of chemical methods to distinguish different functional groups and to identify unknown carbon compounds

nodes.completion_threshold: C≤8 九類官能基命名全對；寫出 4 類官能基反應（試劑、條件、觀察）；以化學測試區分 3 組指定化合物。

difficulty.basis: 九類官能基命名＋三類異構＋反應條件，學習成果數量為全科最多

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XI, p. I-42–I-47；Part II notes XI(a)-(c), p. II-6–II-7
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null。前置依據：Topic XI Overview 明示『Together with the basic concepts and knowledge acquired in the junior secondary course, and Topics V and VI in this curriculum, students build up concepts...』（p. I-42）。

nodes.title: Topic XII Patterns in the Chemical World

items: describe the nature of bonding and structures of the elements from Li to Ar, and the variations in melting point and electrical conductivity
relate the periodic relationship between the acid-base properties of selected oxides
describe the properties of selected transition metals and their compounds

nodes.completion_threshold: 由 Li 至 Ar 解釋熔點與導電性的週期變化；以氧化物酸鹼性排序 3 個指定氧化物；舉 2 個過渡金屬的工業用途。

difficulty.basis: 以週期性規律整合為主，需連結 Topic II 的鍵合概念

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XII, p. I-48–I-50
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈課題層佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。

nodes.title: Topic XIII Industrial Chemistry

items: discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using industrial processes such as petrochemistry from social, economic and environmental perspectives
determine the rate equation of a chemical reaction by the method of initial rate
calculate the atom economy of a chemical reaction
evaluate industrial processes using the principles of green chemistry

nodes.completion_threshold: 給一張未見流程圖：指出各單元操作目的；就 2 個操作條件提出改變並以 equilibrium／rate／成本三軸解釋；計算 atom economy；指出 1 個環境風險點及處理。

difficulty.basis: 流程判讀＋三軸解釋＋綠色化學評估，需整合多個必修課題

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XIII, p. I-51–I-55；Part II notes XIII(a),(b),(f), p. II-8
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈單一選修單元佔分 → weight=null。前置依據：Topic IX Overview『Students can find a further study of catalysis in Topic XIII』（p. I-35）；Topic X Overview『A more in-depth treatment of the above concepts is included in Topic XIII』（p. I-39）。

nodes.title: Topic XIV Materials Chemistry

items: describe the chemical structures and different phases of organic liquid crystals
identify the structural features of substances that exhibit liquid-crystalline behaviour
relate the uses of liquid crystals to their properties

nodes.completion_threshold: 由結構判斷 3 種物質是否具液晶行為；由結構解釋 2 個液晶應用；區分四類固體結構與性質。

difficulty.basis: 範圍集中於液晶與結構—性質關係，官方註記不要求背分子式

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XIV, p. I-56–I-60；Part II note XIV(d), p. II-8
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈單一選修單元佔分 → weight=null；官方未明示前置依賴 → prerequisites=[]。2024 年修讀率 6%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.8），屬自選群體數據。

nodes.title: Topic XV Analytical Chemistry

items: gather data with appropriate instruments and apparatus in quantitative analysis
record observations and data accurately and systematically
be aware of and take necessary steps to minimise possible sources of error
perform calculations on data obtained to draw evidence-based conclusions
justify the choice of an appropriate quantitative method for the determination of the quantity of a substance
assess possible risks associated with quantitative analysis

nodes.completion_threshold: 由 IR／NMR／MS 圖譜指認 3 個未知物；由滴定或比色數據算濃度；為指定樣本選分離與檢測方法並說明理據、誤差來源與風險。

difficulty.basis: 圖譜指認＋定量計算＋誤差與風險評估三線並行

nodes.source: SRC-GUIDE Topic XV, p. I-61–I-65；Part II note XV(c), p. II-9
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈單一選修單元佔分 → weight=null。前置依據：Topic IV Overview『...as well as some basic knowledge for further study in Analytical Chemistry』（p. I-15）。

nodes.title: SBA 校本評核

marking_criteria.status: 官方：SBA Handbook for HKDSE Chemistry (2025), Chapter 2
items: SBA 佔全科 20%；S5 與 S6 各 10%（p.7）
兩年內至少 1 次 VA、1 次 QA、2 次 EXPT；IS 可代替 EXPT（p.7）
評分採 10 分制：10-9 Excellent、8-6 Good、5-3 Fair、2-1 Poor（p.11）
VA 準則：(a) 準確滴定讀數數量足夠並含 trial run；(b) 準確偵測及記錄顏色變化；(c) 計算清楚簡潔（p.10）
QA 準則：(a) 準確記錄及描述結果；(b) 有系統及邏輯地推斷未知物；(c) 顧及實驗室安全（p.10）
EXPT 準則 (a)–(g)：操作技巧、安全、對目標與程序的理解、結果詮釋、記錄與單位、計算、格式（p.10）
IS 準則：proposal (a)–(d)；process and report (a)–(g)（p.11）

nodes.completion_threshold: 完成官方最低評核次數（S5 2 次、S6 2 次），且三類評核均達校內評分標準。

difficulty.basis: 以校內持續評核為主，非一次性公開試

nodes.source: SRC-SBA p.7, p.10-11；SRC-AF p.2-3
nodes.gap_note: SBA 評分準則缺口已由 SBA Handbook (2025) 補齊；各校仍可自訂 marking scheme，分數分配屬校本。2024 年 SBA 平均 74.1%（SRC-BRIEF24 p.9）。

nodes.title: 實驗技能與探究

items: VA：(a) 準確讀數數量足夠並含 trial run；(b) 準確偵測顏色變化；(c) 計算清楚
QA：(a) 準確記錄結果；(b) 有系統推斷未知物；(c) 顧及安全
EXPT：(a) 操作熟練；(b) 安全措施；(c) 理解目標與程序；(d) 準確詮釋結果；(e) 記錄準確、單位正確；(f) 計算準確清楚；(g) 格式恰當
IS：proposal 四項、process and report 七項（p.11）

nodes.completion_threshold: 完成 1 次 VA、1 次 QA、2 次 EXPT；記錄表含單位與不確定度；就 1 個誤差來源提出可執行改良。

difficulty.basis: 滴定精度與誤差分析需反覆操作，但評核範圍明確

nodes.source: SRC-SBA p.10-11；SRC-AF p.2-3
nodes.gap_note: 官方未公佈此子節點獨立佔分 → weight=null；評分為 10 分制，具體分數分配屬校本。

usage_restriction.rule: 僅限內部校準與教研；不得向學生展示原文或逐字內容；如需公開須先取得 HKEAA 書面許可。

ms_inventory.basis: 同位素豐度與相對原子質量計算
金剛石與石墨的巨形共價結構比較
points: 共同點：同為 giant covalent structure
差異：金剛石每碳 4 鍵、石墨每碳 3 鍵
導電性由 delocalised electrons 有無決定

ms_inventory.basis: 生鏽條件與犧牲性保護
points: 以藍色出現與否推論誰失電子
Fe2+ 與 hexacyanoferrate(III) 生成藍色

ms_inventory.basis: 化學電池、鹽橋、電化學序
points: 鹽橋作用：完成電路／平衡電荷／容許離子流動
AgCl 沉澱會阻塞離子流動
回滴定：鹼的總摩爾數減去與酸反應部分
